# Retrieve Dynamic Updates
<mark style="background: #ABF7F7A6;">Operational mode ></mark>

## Applications and Threats
```
request content upgrade check
```
```
request content upgrade download latest
```
> You will need to verify the job completed before running the install command
> how jobs id <jobid>
```
request content upgrade install version latest
```
> verify the job completed
## Antivirus
```
request anti-virus upgrade check
```
```
request anti-virus upgrade download latest
```
```
request anti-virus upgrade install version latest
```
## Wildfire
```
request wildfire upgrade check
```
```
request wildfire upgrade download latest
```
```
request wildfire upgrade install version latest
```


# Check for Available PAN-OS Software Versions
<mark style="background: #ABF7F7A6;">Operational mode ></mark>
```
request system software check
```
```
request system software download version <version_number>
```
```
request system software install version <version_number>
```
```
request restart system
```

# Check After
admin@PA-440> <mark style="background: #D2B3FFA6;">show system info</mark>
